name: AmmonixRCM-Writer-9B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-9B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 24 of 32 layers are linear_attention and 8 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A LoRA r=32 merge of ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-9B, not a new base model: same config.json. The repo ships merged weights and also the un-merged adapter/ folder, so it is not an adapter-only repo. Recorded as a contender because it publishes same-table evidence against its own base - but read that evidence narrowly: both rows are payer outcomes on a fully synthetic claims world (200 demonstration claims, 525 decision points), both are lower-is-better, and neither is comparable to any benchmark row elsewhere in this catalog. The card is explicit that the model only writes paperwork inside the RCM agent harness and never makes the decision, and that it has never seen a real claim, payer rule or denial code.
